# Spice Station Silver Lake

> A specialty spice and herb e-commerce shop offering curated international seasoning blends, gourmet salts, dried chiles, and culinary ingredients from around the world.

Spice Station Silver Lake is a Los Angeles-based spice merchant featuring Chef D. Harmon signature blends, medicinal herbs, and specialty ingredients sourced from regions including India, France, China, Italy, and Morocco. The shop specializes in both individual spices and carefully crafted seasoning blends for home cooks and professional chefs.

## Shop by Product Type

- [Spices](https://spicestationsilverlake.com/product-category/spices): International spices from India, Jamaica, and Poland for culinary use
- [Herbs](https://spicestationsilverlake.com/product-category/herbs): Culinary and medicinal herbs including Egyptian and USA basil varieties
- [Blends](https://spicestationsilverlake.com/product-category/blends): Spice blends catalog with Chef D. Harmon signature and specialty mixes
- [Chiles](https://spicestationsilverlake.com/product-category/chiles): Dried chiles catalog featuring Aji Amarillo and Aleppo Pepper varieties
- [Peppercorns](https://spicestationsilverlake.com/product-category/peppercorn): Specialty peppercorn varieties: Black Pepper, Cubeb Berry, Grains of Paradise
- [Salts](https://spicestationsilverlake.com/product-category/salts): Gourmet salts including Alaea Hawaiian Red Salt and Black Garlic Salt
- [Teas](https://spicestationsilverlake.com/product-category/teas): Herbal and specialty teas including Ashwagandha and Bourbon Vanilla Rooibos
- [Sugars](https://spicestationsilverlake.com/product-category/sugars): Infused sugars: Cinnamon, Clove, and Dark Cocoa Sugar for baking

## Featured Collections

- [Chef D. Harmon Signature Blends](https://spicestationsilverlake.com/product-category/blends/chef-d-harmon-signature-blends): Chef D. Harmon signature blends: Gouldtown Ranch and H-1 Steak Seasoning
- [Salt-Free Blends](https://spicestationsilverlake.com/product-category/blends/salt-free): Salt-free seasoning blends including Bouquet Garni and Chicken Tagine

## Shop by Cuisine

- [Indian](https://spicestationsilverlake.com/product-category/cuisine/indian): Indian spices: Garam Masala, Chai Masala, Biryani, and Asafoetida
- [French](https://spicestationsilverlake.com/product-category/cuisine/french): French culinary spices and Provence herbs for gourmet cooking
- [Italian](https://spicestationsilverlake.com/product-category/cuisine/italian): Italian spices and Aglio Olio Seasoning for Mediterranean cuisine
- [Chinese](https://spicestationsilverlake.com/product-category/cuisine/chinese): Chinese spices featuring Szechuan peppercorn and Asian cuisine blends
- [Caribbean](https://spicestationsilverlake.com/product-category/cuisine/caribbean): Caribbean spices: Jerk Rub, Coconut Colombo, Jamaican Curry blends
- [African](https://spicestationsilverlake.com/product-category/cuisine/african): African spices and blends featuring Ethiopian Berbere seasoning
- [Israeli](https://spicestationsilverlake.com/product-category/cuisine/israeli): Israeli and Mediterranean spices for Middle Eastern and kosher cooking
